arcs.title: Flashpoint
arcs.description: Grande evento DC che altera la continuità dell'universo DC. La componente Green Lantern comprende i tie-in dedicati a Hal Jordan e Abin Sur.

series.title: Flashpoint: Abin Sur – The Green Lantern

arcs.title: Twilight of the Guardians
arcs.description: Arco di Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps incentrato sui Guardiani e sul conflitto con i Controllers.

series.title: Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps

arcs.title: Last Charge
arcs.description: Arco conclusivo di Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps. La testata è classificata nella colonna Green Lantern.

series.title: Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps

arcs.title: Sinestro
arcs.description: The opening story arc of the 2011 Green Lantern series, in which Sinestro is given a Green Lantern ring and returns to Korugar to confront the Sinestro Corps, while Hal Jordan struggles without his ring.

arcs.title: The Secret of the Indigo Tribe
arcs.description: Hal Jordan and Sinestro investigate the Indigo Tribe and uncover its origins and connection to Abin Sur, while the Guardians advance their plan to replace the Green Lantern Corps.

arcs.title: The Revenge of Black Hand
arcs.description: Black Hand returns with greater power after being freed from the Indigo Tribe. Hal Jordan and Sinestro face a new threat tied to death and the wider plans unfolding around the Green Lantern Corps.
